name: hollywood-groove-functions
description: Firebase Cloud Functions for Hollywood Groove scoring and engagement

scripts.serve: npm run build && JAVA_HOME=${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home} npm run firebase -- emulators:start --only functions,auth,database,firestore --config ../../firebase.json --project theta-inkwell-448908-g9
scripts.shell: npm run build && npm run firebase -- functions:shell --config ../firebase.json --project theta-inkwell-448908-g9
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run firebase -- deploy --only functions --config ../firebase.json --project theta-inkwell-448908-g9
